prompt.alinti: Turn your PDFs, videos, websites, and notes into a private AI research assistant. Chat with your content, generate summaries, create podcasts, and keep everything private by running it locally on your own computer.

If you keep hitting AI usage limits while coding, this repository can help. It connects tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Cline to hundreds of models, then automatically switches providers when one runs out of quota.
